text: DSH Chat Manager（DSH 网页插件）：在归档会话中搜索聊天内容，并恢复或清理会话。它通过 DSH 设置页、会话菜单和宿主服务接入归档管理。主要功能包括搜索归档消息并查看片段、取消归档、为删除操作再次确认，以及删除符合条件的未加载本机 JSONL 会话。适合需要整理 DSH 聊天历史的用户；需要兼容的 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 会话服务。

DSH Chat Manager is a web plugin for searching archived messages and managing sessions. Its settings page shows snippets and lets users unarchive chats; a named confirmation is required before deleting an eligible unloaded local JSONL session. It requires DSH 0.2.2-rc.1.
想从旧归档聊天里搜一句话，找回对应的会话。
有没有办法只搜索已归档的消息并看一小段上下文？
我想把归档过的会话恢复到原来的工作区。
归档列表里有不再需要的会话，怎样清理记录？
能在会话菜单里发起删除并先确认会话名称吗？
帮我整理历史会话，同时保留正在运行的会话不受影响。
I need to find a phrase in my archived conversations and reopen the matching session.
Can I search archived messages and see a short matching snippet?
How can I remove an old archived local session after confirming which one it is?
I want to restore an archived chat without losing its workspace placement.
DSH Chat Manager 的功能「归档内容搜索」：按关键词搜索已归档的用户和助手消息，并显示匹配片段。用户在设置页输入查询；结果限 20 条，全文索引不可用时改用分批扫描。
DSH Chat Manager 的功能「取消归档」：从设置页对归档会话执行 DSH 的公开取消归档操作，并保留工作区位置。用户点击对应行的取消归档按钮即可恢复会话。
DSH Chat Manager 的功能「确认删除会话」：用户从归档设置页或会话菜单选中记录后，会看到带会话名称的确认框。确认后才向宿主发送删除请求，取消则关闭对话框。
DSH Chat Manager 的功能「清理已归档会话」：确认后删除符合条件的本机当前格式 JSONL 会话目录。只接受已归档且未加载的会话；宿主仍在使用、格式未知或无法取得独占写入句柄时会拒绝。
DSH Chat Manager 的功能「同步归档列表」：删除成功后调用公开取消归档操作，清除已移除会话的归档标记；如果标记更新失败，接口会返回未完成状态供界面提示。
DSH Chat Manager 使用前须知：永久删除会移除已归档本机会话记录且无法恢复；仅支持未加载、当前格式的 JSONL 会话，已加载或未知格式会被拒绝。（见 src/host/delete-session.mjs:121-188）

text:
dsh-chat-manager README · v2 范围：官方 DSH 负责常规会话浏览、搜索、归档、停止后归档和取消归档。
本插件通过公共扩展 slot 增加一个独立的“归档内容搜索与清理”设置页：

- 搜索归档会话的当前用户和助手消息，先限定归档 ID，再限制结果数量；可显示片段。
- 可选全文索引关闭时，保留四路并发的后备扫描。结果最多 20 条；取消或更改查询会停止后续批次。
- 恢复使用官方公开的取消归档操作，保留原工作区位置。
- 设置页和归档行菜单共用带会话名称的二次确认，取消不发送删除请求。
- 永久删除只接受已归档、未被宿主加载的本机当前格式 JSONL 会话，并须取得官方独占写入句柄。
  已加载的空闲或运行中会话、其他写入者、需迁移或未知格式均会被拒绝。

停止任务或归档不保证宿主已卸载会话。本插件不会停止或摘载其他组件拥有的 Agent，
也不会为了删除而自动迁移会话。操作后只刷新官方列表，不接管会话导航。

这是独立插件；本次工作不将它预装进官方桌面 1.x，也不修改官方 ASAR。

dsh-chat-manager README · 安装、更新与卸载：请勿将本工作树或未发布候选安装到日常 profile。需要稳定版时，先核对目标 DSH、profile、`latest` 解析出的实际版本及其 peer 要求，再按
[stable 安装指南](https://github.com/WSL043/dsh-chat-manager/blob/stable/AGENTS.md)操作。
在官方 **插件 → 添加插件** 页面输入 `dsh-chat-manager@latest`；
不要仅凭本分支 package.json 推断包已发布或适合当前宿主。

安装、更新或卸载只操作明确选定的插件层，保留会话、其他插件和用户配置。
仅在用户允许后重启 DSH。卸载通过官方插件页面移除本插件；卸载本身不删除会话。
Agent 操作须遵循本分支 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) 和上述 stable 指南的安装保护，执行安装时固定已解析的确切版本。

稳定维护每小时检测上游；兼容补丁通过验收后自动发布到 npm 和 GitHub Releases，失败则停发并报告错误。此流程不发布或扩大 v2 候选的支持范围。

dsh-chat-manager README · 安全边界：**永久删除无法撤销。** 确认前请核对会话名称并备份需要保留的内容。
插件只验证并移除用户确认的目标会话独立 JSONL 目录；路径、身份或写入所有权
无法确认时拒绝继续。未完成的清理保留隔离区并如实报告，归档标记更新失败不会隐藏。

本功能不是安全擦除，不涵盖外部附件、缓存、日志、备份、云端副本、其他会话或非 JSONL 存储。
未经用户明确选择并确认的一次性测试会话，不得用于破坏性验收。

dsh-chat-manager README · v2 scope：Official DSH owns normal session browsing, search, archive, stop-and-archive and unarchive.
This plugin adds one public-slot settings page for archive content search and cleanup:

dsh-chat-manager README · v2 scope：- Search current user and assistant messages within archived IDs before applying the result limit, with plain-text snippets.
- Keep a four-concurrent-scan fallback when the optional full-text index is disabled. At most 20 results are returned; cancelling or changing a query stops subsequent batches.
- Restore through the official public unarchive operation, preserving the recorded workspace position.
- The settings page and archived row menu share a second confirmation naming the exact session. Cancellation sends no delete request.
- Permanent deletion requires an archived, unloaded local session in current JSONL format and an exclusive official persistence write handle.
  Loaded idle/running sessions, other writers, migration-required and unknown formats are refused.

dsh-chat-manager README · v2 scope：Stopping work or archiving does not guarantee that the host unloaded the session.
The plugin does not stop or dispose another component's Agent and does not migrate sessions for deletion.
After an operation it refreshes public lists; navigation stays with official DSH.

This is an independent plugin. This work does not preinstall it into official Desktop 1.x or modify an official ASAR.

The test used generated sessions; existing user installations and real-model calls were not validated.

dsh-chat-manager README · Install, update and uninstall：Do not install this working tree or unpublished candidate into a daily profile.
For the stable release, check the target DSH, profile, actual version resolved by `latest`, and its peer requirements.
Follow the [stable installation guide](https://github.com/WSL043/dsh-chat-manager/blob/stable/AGENTS.md)
and enter `dsh-chat-manager@latest` on the official **Plugins → Add plugin** page.
Do not infer publication or host suitability from this branch's package.json.

dsh-chat-manager README · Install, update and uninstall：Install, update and uninstall only the selected plugin layer; preserve sessions, unrelated plugins and user configuration.
Restart DSH only with the user's permission. Remove the plugin through the official plugin page; uninstalling does not delete sessions.
Agents must follow [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) and the stable guide above, pinning the verified resolved version when installing.

dsh-chat-manager README · Install, update and uninstall：Stable maintenance checks upstream every hour. Compatibility patches publish automatically to npm and GitHub Releases after acceptance; failures block publication and report an error. This process does not publish or widen support for the v2 candidate.

dsh-chat-manager README · Safety boundary：**Permanent deletion cannot be undone.** Verify the named target and back up anything needed before confirming.
The plugin validates and removes only the confirmed session's independent JSONL directory.
Uncertain paths, identity or writer ownership are refused. Incomplete cleanup retains the quarantine and is reported;
a failed archive-marker update remains visible.

dsh-chat-manager README · Safety boundary：This is not secure erasure. External attachments, caches, logs, backups, cloud copies, other sessions and non-JSONL stores are outside its scope.
A destructive acceptance test requires a disposable fixture session explicitly selected and confirmed by the user.
